# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book is a tidyverse-based re-implementation of the
[NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/),
originally published as a static HTML handbook with worked examples in
[Dataplot](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/software/dataplot/).

Each chapter follows the structure of the original handbook, but the worked
examples are reproduced using R and the [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org/)
family of packages (`dplyr`, `tidyr`, `ggplot2`, `purrr`, `broom`, and related
extensions). Original datasets are retained for reference and validation.

The source content for this migration lives in `handbook/` at the root of
this repository.
